* Home  
* Move. Measure. Change.  
  Cities in motion. Air under control.  
  We turned the city into a sensor.  
* Problem You can't fix what you can't measure.  
> > > * 330K+	Premature deaths per year from air pollution in Europe  
> > > * 95%	Of urban Europeans exposed to unsafe air pollutant levels  
> > > * 50K	EU companies required to report verified air data under CSRD from 2025  
> > > * The new EU Air Quality Directive 2024 sets stricter limits, meaning many cities that were previously compliant are now in violation  
> > > * 5–10%	Of city area covered by stationary monitoring stations.  
> > > * One stationary monitoring station costs €50,000–€150,000, making dense networks financially impossible  
    
* Solution – ADAM \-AI Driven Air Monitoring (what is ADAM and how it works)  
  ADAM is a mobile AI-driven air quality monitoring system that turns partner vehicle fleets — taxis, delivery, and logistics — into a network of street-level sensors, giving cities full real-time coverage at a fraction of the cost of stationary stations.

* Why ADAM

  Full city coverage 	Vehicles cover 100% of city streets — not just 10 fixed points. Every street, every neighborhood, every hour.

  AI-validated data	Up to 96% accuracy on validated direct measurements. Over 100,000 measurements per vehicle per year continuously improve our models.

  CSRD-ready reports	Auto-generated ESRS E1/E2 compliant reports accepted by EU regulators, auditors and banks. One click — the report is ready.

  10× more affordable	One stationary station costs €50,000–€150,000. ADAM covers an entire city via partner fleets at a fraction of that cost.

  EN 15267-4 certification	Targeting the only standard that makes mobile air quality data legally recognised for regulatory reporting and ESG audits.

  Asset-light model	No proprietary fleet required. We partner with existing taxi and logistics operators — rapid deployment, low capital cost.
